description: This file contains functions and logic for handling NAND flash upgrades in OpenWrt, including identifying, verifying, and flashing firmware images such as UBI, UBIFS, FIT, and tar archives, as well as managing UBI volumes and partitions.

methods.name: ubi_mknod
methods.description: Creates a device node for a UBI volume based on directory info.

methods.name: nand_find_volume
methods.description: Finds a UBI volume by name within a given UBI device.

methods.name: nand_find_ubi
methods.description: Finds the UBI device name associated with a given partition.

methods.name: nand_get_magic_long
methods.description: Reads magic number from NAND image.

methods.name: get_magic_long_tar
methods.description: Reads magic number from tar archive.

methods.name: identify
methods.description: Identifies the type of NAND image based on magic number.

methods.name: identify_tar
methods.description: Identifies the type of tar archive based on magic number.

methods.name: identify_if_gzip
methods.description: Checks if the file is gzip compressed.

methods.name: nand_restore_config
methods.description: Restores configuration from backup to UBI volume.

methods.name: nand_remove_ubiblock
methods.description: Removes a UBI block device.

methods.name: nand_attach_ubi
methods.description: Attaches a UBI partition and returns its device name.

methods.name: nand_detach_ubi
methods.description: Detaches a UBI partition.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_prepare_ubi
methods.description: Prepares UBI volumes for upgrade, creating or removing volumes as needed.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_ubinized
methods.description: Flashes a ubinized UBI image to the device.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_ubifs
methods.description: Flashes a UBIFS image to the UBI root volume.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_fit
methods.description: Flashes a FIT image to the UBI kernel volume.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_tar
methods.description: Flashes images from a tar archive to appropriate partitions or volumes.

methods.name: nand_verify_if_gzip_file
methods.description: Verifies integrity of gzip compressed firmware file.

methods.name: nand_verify_tar_file
methods.description: Verifies integrity of tar archive.

methods.name: nand_do_flash_file
methods.description: Identifies and flashes a firmware file based on its type.

methods.name: nand_do_restore_config
methods.description: Restores configuration backup if present.

methods.name: nand_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main function to perform firmware upgrade from a file.

methods.name: nand_do_upgrade_success
methods.description: Handles successful upgrade procedures.

methods.name: nand_do_upgrade_failed
methods.description: Handles failed upgrade procedures.

methods.name: nand_do_platform_check
methods.description: Checks if a firmware file is valid for upgrade on this platform.
